scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/seams packages/hy-cli packages/sdk && tsc -p packages/hy-cli/tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/seams && tsc --noEmit -p packages/hy-cli && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk && tsc --noEmit -p packages/hy-cli/tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop:package: node scripts/check-portable-lock.mjs && pnpm build && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.desktop:package:next: pnpm build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.directories.output=release/next && node scripts/tag-next-artifact.mjs
scripts.desktop:package:dir: node scripts/check-portable-lock.mjs && pnpm build && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.test:regression: node --test --import ./tests/integration/isolate.mjs --import ./tests/integration/fresh-build.mjs --test-isolation=none --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 tests/regression/golden.test.mjs tests/integration/chat-resume.test.mjs tests/integration/guardian.test.mjs tests/integration/verifier-ralph.test.mjs tests/integration/turn-queue.test.mjs tests/integration/mcp-server.test.mjs tests/integration/tool-overhead.test.mjs
